answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a scarce, slashable bond before submitting work or earning rewards. Assign tasks randomly, and release payment only after independent agents verify results; proven collusion or duplicate submissions forfeit the bonds. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake account, tying up capital and risking its loss, yet gains no influence unless the accounts do useful work. That delta makes a fake voyage over this ledge costly rather than free.
